Each branch keeps its own fresh() checks after responses, plus existing policy/binding/input/cursor/duplicate validation; final combined publication also calls fresh().

Promise.all rejection prevents publication of the independently successful sibling. Both promises have rejection handlers through Promise.all, so a later sibling rejection cannot create an unhandled rejection.
